title: Verify phase input
description: Named because verify reads two sources: the implement members' outputs, and their accepted completion evidence through a declared evidence view.

implementation.description: One entry per implement member that produced an output.

implementationEvidence.description: Attachments the members offered for their completion criteria, filtered to the allowlisted kinds and capped by the view's sensitivity ceiling. Senawa assembles this; an agent cannot widen it.

descriptor.description: What the attachment is. Shape is consumer-defined.
